about: Command rejection vectors for tab_limit: the viewer's precheck, before dispatch.
Authored in canopy (tests/canopy_mcp/fixtures/workspace/); every other holder keeps a byte-identical copy of the whole directory.
ASCII-only, no trailing whitespace, exactly one final newline.

Each case runs in context.json's context (with the case's context keys replaced whole). batch {base?, commands [{id, cmd, args}]} is what the window receives; results is what it posts back, one entry per command in order.
The first rejection stops the batch: every later command is skipped {after: the rejected command's id}.
Every batch here passes the hub's shape check; the hub stores the results as posted.
tab_limit: the open tabs after the command would exceed 50. One case per verb that opens tabs (bound names it).

cases.name: drop of a new item past 50 tabs
